intro: Iran has around 90 million people from many ethnic groups, united by Persian language and a long shared history.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: Persians are the largest group, with large numbers of Azerbaijanis (Azeris), Kurds, Lurs, Arabs, Baloch and Turkmen. Persian (Farsi) is the official language.
Most people are Shia Muslims; there are also Sunni Muslims, Christians, Jews, Zoroastrians and Baha'is.

chapters.title: Young and urban
text: Most Iranians live in cities; Tehran has over 9 million people. Many young people are university educated, and more than half of university students have been women.
Women must wear a headscarf in public by law, a rule many have protested against.
